title: Why Write About Climate Change?
author: Robert Hunziker
content:
Getty and Unsplash+. After 15 years of researching climate change, writing
articles based upon peer-reviewed science, it has become clear as a bell that
it is an existential threat to all forms of life sooner rather than later,
meaning current lifetimes. There’s a strange rattle in the air that’s spooky.
